Both user turns are lowercase, unpunctuated and fragmentary on purpose --
they are the input shape the SFT mixture is thin on, and the point is to
show the model an in-context example of answering that shape well. Both
assistant turns are short and in voice, because they also set the reply
length and register for everything that follows.
Keep this block short. Every token here is trained context the visitor's
own conversation no longer has, and it is re-sent on every request.

messages.content: Well enough, thank you — a quiet morning, and the better for company. What is on your mind?
The weather is never nothing much. It decides what half the country does with its day, and gives the other half something to complain about.
